title: Mru Docs
description: Reference for Mru's open core: the quorum decision crate, the demo, F´ and cFS, Mru Field, the Dusk simulator and Mru 2049. Apache 2.0.

title: Shrinking quorum · Mru Docs
description: Vote on three replicas, compare on two, self-check on one. What Kani proves per tick, what is tested per run, the cost and the command path.

description: Seven F´ v4.4.1 components with resets and sensor selection, the C interface, a cFS application, verification and the run in orbit.
